title.zh: 【Salus CMO：CoinDCX 疑似被盗约 1599 万 USDT 及部分 TRX】
title.en: 【Salus CMO：CoinDCX 疑似被盗约 1599 万 USDT 及部分 TRX】

current_state.zh: Salus's CMO reported that roughly 15.99 million USDT and 5,783.81 TRX moved out of CoinDCX hot wallets and deposit addresses to a TRON address on October 21, with the funds subsequently split and transferred toward Binance, OKX and Gate deposit addresses, in what is being described as a suspected theft.
